summary: MaterialDNA validation can cross-wire already-known visual/physical/acoustic family keys across otherwise coherent built-in recipes because profile coherence labels are checked but the known semantic family/class keys are not related to the recipe family. Draft docs PR #472 records a bounded non-duplicate follow-up without changing product behavior.
evidence: Audited MaterialDNA source at main eead13b2e90ffbba36248909d97e17856e002ad9 and the current MaterialDNA contract/tests/fixture catalog. validateRecipe() requires profile coherenceClass values to equal the recipe coherenceClass but does not relate visual.familyKey, physical.classKey, or acoustic.classKey to the known recipe family.

Exact source-level repro: start from the valid commercial wallpaper recipe and change only physical.classKey to the already-shipped physics.low-pile-carpet key while leaving wallpaper coherence labels, finish.vinyl-wallpaper, substrate.gypsum-board, and installation.pasted-wallpaper unchanged; no current compatibility predicate rejects that known-family contradiction.

The same defect class applies to the shipped acoustic.low-pile-carpet key. This is distinct from the existing cross-domain coherence regression, which mutates acoustic.coherenceClass itself, and from PR #283 fixture-content seals, which protect shipped fixture bytes rather than arbitrary caller recipes.

Existing MaterialDNA work for repairCount integer bounds, validation/diagnostic density bounds, percent key grammar, hostile unknown-key execution, and fixture drift was explicitly inspected and excluded as duplicate scope.

Draft PR #472 head 374da8e8cd52bec78ec0cc086ff3f362f5896001 adds only Docs/MATERIAL_DNA_KNOWN_FAMILY_COHERENCE_FINDING.md. Exact-head canonical CI run 31780067240 passes. No product source, schema, fixture, identity, Studio, physics, audio, networking, persistence, or multiplayer evidence is claimed.

While the finding was published, product main advanced through unrelated PR #462 to c09e3385702c76b8664fb1dcb2116321a0eaf083 with canonical main CI run 31779560841 passing. PR #472 remains mergeable with one effective docs file change.

Swarm run 31780067213 is independently fail-closed because authoritative swarm-control contains two newer malformed immutable x4m9p2c7 runtime-schema events with unsupported top-level pr/headSha fields; deterministic/adversarial engine tests pass before the read-only trust-bootstrap validation rejects those events. This finding does not edit or normalize those immutable bytes.

metadata.recommendedNext: After the currently owned MaterialDNA validator leaves converge, add a narrow explicit known-family compatibility boundary and deterministic regressions for wallpaper plus known carpet physical/acoustic keys. Do not infer compatibility from string prefixes, do not create a generic material registry, preserve unknown future semantic keys until deliberately defined, and do not change schema/id/recipeVersion/MaterialRef or shipped fixture content.
